text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
To win in battle...
is truly a steep and arduous road...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Still, if I take it step by step...
Without a doubt... without a doubt...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: I cannot simply give up halfway through my ambition...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, fatigue seems to be catching up to her.
I might need to reconsider No Reason's
upcoming race schedule...
